title: Yellow Spiced Egyptian Lamb Kebabs
description: Rich and creamy Egyptian dish featuring lamb kebabs grilled to perfection, served with a side of warm water and spices, sugar-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the kebabs are cooking, mix the yellow spice mix with 1 tablespoon of warm water.
Brush the spice mixture onto the kebabs during the last minute of cooking.
Serve the kebabs hot with a side of warm water and additional spices if desired.
